notes.title: 🏆The Anomalous Hour v1.2g: Achievement Fix and Two New Anomalies❓
notes.notes:
Attention, anomaly seekers!

The Anomalous Hour v1.2g is now live. We discovered two new anomalies lurking in the darkness and we fixed an achievement-related bug. Here's the full patch notes:

🏆Bug Fix for Finale - Type Alpha: There was a bug affecting the achievement 'Finale - Type Alpha', making some players unable to unlock it. The bug is gone now.

❓ Two New Anomalies: Our readings indicate that there are two previously undiscovered anomalies emerging inside the The Anomalous Hour. As always, caution is advised.

Thank you for your unending, tireless, infinite, hard work. We bid you a safe return to The Anomalous Hour.

notes.title: 🎯 Version 1.2: Discover New Endings and New Achievements 🏆
notes.notes:
Attention, anomaly seekers!

Based on your exploration reports, we have enacted the latest update (version 1.2) for The Anomalous Hours. We've made the following astounding discoveries:

📹 Five New Endings: We've confirmed reports from seekers that there are 5 new endings to The Anomalous Hour. If you want to get out, we advise you to find these endings. But be warned: not all endings are happy endings.

👹 New Behavior for Anomalies: We've detected a change in behavior for two anomalies: The Gruesome and The Stalker. We advise you to practice utmost caution when interacting with these anomalies.

🏆 New Achievements: Tied to the new endings, there are achievements you can get by discovering these endings. 

Thank you for your tireless support and feedback, seekers. We wish for your safe return from your next foray into the Anomalous Hour. Remember, you can take a man out of the Anomalous Hour, but you can't take The Anomalous Hour out of the man.

notes.title: 📸 Update Announcement: Version 1.1c Now Live! 📸
notes.notes:
Attention, anomaly seekers!

We are ready to unveil the latest update (Version 1.1c) for The Anomalous Hours, based on your invaluable exploration data and reports. Here's what's new:

📷 Improved Camera Movement Sensitivity: We've fine-tuned the camera controls to provide smoother, more responsive movement, to better facilitate your expedition during the Anomalous Hours.

🐛 Bug Fixed (Walkgoing and Running Speed): We've resolved a potentially anomalous bug affecting walking and running speeds, ensuring more fluid and consistent in-game movements.

🎮 Updated Game Props: We have updated several items around the station to match closer with expected baseline reality.  

🔧 Minor Bug Fixes: We've combed through your reports and addressed several minor bugs to provide as much stability as possible during your excursions.

Thank you for your tireless support and feedback, seekers. We wish for your safe return from your next foray into the Anomalous Hour.

notes.title: The Anomalous Hour is Out! Enjoy the 10% Launch Discount
notes.notes:
Attention, anomaly seekers!

The Anomalous Hour is out now.

There's an urban legend going around that there's a hidden hour on the day, called the Anomalous Hour. People trapped inside it will find themselves surrounded by bizarre, otherworldly anomalies. Everything is not as they seem.

It's just your lucky day. As you're making your way home, you plan to take the subway as usual. But as the clock strikes twelve, something is off. The noises from the station turned silent. The other commuters have seemingly disappeared into the thin air.

Something is off. The air feels thicker. The light is too garish; it's hurting your eyes. But the darkness offers no comfort either, it's murky and you can swear something just moved in the shadows.

You find yourself in The Anomalous Hour.

Luckily, you remember another part of the rumor: take pictures of the anomaly you find, then board the train. Do it enough times and you'll find your way out. That is, if you don't succumb to the madness first.

Play The Anomalous Hour now and prove your courage. Find more than 30 different anomalies lurking, creeping on every corner. Some are obvious; others are subtle. Find them all to complete the Steam achievements, making you a master of anomalies.

Enjoy a 10% launch discount until May 6th to get your ticket to The Anomalous Hour. We claim no responsibility if you find yourself unable to get out of it.
